title: Enhancing Creativity in Software Architecture: Exploring Creative Architecting Limiters and Enablers Through Practitioner Insights
abstract: Creativity is crucial for software practitioners who solve complex problems daily. Despite existing guidelines for architectural decision-making, creativity in software architecture remains unexplored. To address this, we conducted twelve semi-structured interviews, which we analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis. We found that due to the inherently interesting nature of architectural decision-making, architects naturally strive to be creative. However, this drive can be hindered by various Limiters, notably time pressure. Additionally, we found a set of creativity Enablers related to team organization and workplace design. These findings can help practitioners in enhancing creative architecting in their companies.
